comments.body:
Phase 1 RCA dossier and conclusion:

Step 0(a): tracker sweep for `exact-patchset checkout wrong patchset SHA Jira DC` found this ticket only; open/in_progress bug list showed no duplicate for this symptom.
Step 0(b): ticket created_at 1788294772433754001 => reported floor `1c8232b0ee4e943f021cb51b63d16656e7f4df0e`; suspect workflow changed after floor (`5ff99170b5d0`, `024a6a227813`) but the failing workflow itself was introduced by `a22257e7d10e3d079ee676cbb38d2b39811d0fd5` / ticket `3f27-cb3c-8023-4f57`.
Step 0(c): worktree `/Users/joeoakhart/debug-897e-checkout` at `024a6a2278134128be0c76c8d7c60e41b4ba817d`, equal to `origin/main`.

Observed failure: GitHub Actions run 33455923923 failed in `Verify the checkout landed on the exact patchset SHA` before Jira DC setup. The log shows checkout action inputs `gerrit-refspec: refs/changes/66/2466/1` and `ref: a22257e7d10e3d079ee676cbb38d2b39811d0fd5`; the verify step then observed `HEAD=d6c37680805fc8ae013832dd4c09c1fb100a1e0b` while expected was `a22257e7d10e3d079ee676cbb38d2b39811d0fd5`.

Discriminating evidence: Gerrit change 2466 metadata reports patchset 1 (`refs/changes/66/2466/1`) revision `d6c37680805fc8ae013832dd4c09c1fb100a1e0b`, and patchset 2/current revision `a22257e7d10e3d079ee676cbb38d2b39811d0fd5`. `git ls-remote origin refs/changes/66/2466/1` and `git ls-remote gerrit refs/changes/66/2466/1` both resolve to `d6c37680805fc8ae013832dd4c09c1fb100a1e0b`. That rejects the "checkout action rebased/merged" hypothesis: the pinned action source runs `actions/checkout` at `${{ github.sha }}`, then `git fetch origin ${{ inputs.gerrit-refspec }}` (or Gerrit fallback), then `git checkout FETCH_HEAD`, so it deterministically leaves HEAD at the refspec commit. It also rejects "newer patchset race resolved latest" for the checkout itself: it fetched the exact stale refspec it was given.

Confirmed root cause: `.github/workflows/jira-dc-exact-patchset.yml` delegated the checkout to `lfreleng-actions/checkout-gerrit-change-action`, whose contract is refspec-first and not SHA-pinned: if `GERRIT_REFSPEC` and `GERRIT_PATCHSET_REVISION` disagree, it checks out `FETCH_HEAD` from the refspec and only the later guard notices the SHA mismatch. The workflow therefore lacks an early deterministic input-pair validation/checkout-by-requested-SHA seam. The guard was correct to fail closed, but the workflow allowed an inconsistent dispatch pair to become a wrong checkout before reporting it as a wrong-ref guard failure.

Defect legitimacy: defect. The ticket/workflow contract explicitly requires the exact requested Gerrit patchset SHA before live DC operations; the mismatch violates that intended behavior.

Defect origin: ticket `3f27-cb3c-8023-4f57` (`single-vast-roan`) / commit `a22257e7d10e3d079ee676cbb38d2b39811d0fd5`, by scope-of-work and introducing commit. That commit added `.github/workflows/jira-dc-exact-patchset.yml` with the third-party refspec checkout action and post-hoc SHA guard, but did not validate that `GERRIT_REFSPEC` resolves to `GERRIT_PATCHSET_REVISION` before the live lane. This is a plan_defect in the original exact-patchset lane plan, not an unrelated later regression.

Repair plan: replace the third-party checkout step in this workflow with explicit shell plumbing that fetches the exact `GERRIT_REFSPEC` from the GitHub mirror, falls back to Gerrit if needed, verifies `FETCH_HEAD == GERRIT_PATCHSET_REVISION`, checks out the requested SHA explicitly, then verifies `HEAD == GERRIT_PATCHSET_REVISION` before setup/live DC steps. Strengthen the existing workflow contract test to fail RED on the current third-party-action shape and require the early fetch/input error semantics.

## Observed signal
Error sweep window 2026-08-30T21:20:00-07:00..2026-09-01T11:58:00-07:00 (2026-08-31T04:20:00Z..2026-09-01T18:58:00Z) found GitHub Actions run 33455923923 (`Jira DC Exact-Patchset Parity`, workflow_dispatch, triggered by JoeOakhartNava) failed before executing the live DC parity body.

Failing job: `jira DC exact-patchset parity (real Jira Data Center, ephemeral)` at step `Verify the checkout landed on the exact patchset SHA`.

Error:
`checked-out HEAD (d6c37680805fc8ae013832dd4c09c1fb100a1e0b) does not match the requested Gerrit patchset revision (a22257e7d10e3d079ee676cbb38d2b39811d0fd5) — refusing to run the DC lane against the wrong ref.`

## Confirmed root cause
Gerrit change 2466 patchset 1 (`refs/changes/66/2466/1`) resolves to `d6c37680805fc8ae013832dd4c09c1fb100a1e0b`; patchset 2/current resolves to `a22257e7d10e3d079ee676cbb38d2b39811d0fd5`. Run 33455923923 combined the patchset-1 refspec with the patchset-2 revision. The pinned `checkout-gerrit-change-action` first checks out its `ref` default (`github.sha`) but then fetches `GERRIT_REFSPEC` and unconditionally checks out `FETCH_HEAD`, so the workflow landed on the stale refspec commit and only the later guard detected the mismatch.

The guard's fail-closed behavior is correct. The defect is that `.github/workflows/jira-dc-exact-patchset.yml` delegates the final checkout to a refspec-first third-party action even though this lane's authoritative requested commit is the `(GERRIT_REFSPEC, GERRIT_PATCHSET_REVISION)` pair.

## Fix plan
Replace only this workflow's first checkout step with explicit shell plumbing equivalent to the pinned action's fetch protocol, but with the missing SHA validation inserted before checkout. This is not a new protocol: the pinned action source at `lfreleng-actions/checkout-gerrit-change-action@f87b90a3370e62dad310797fedc7fd3700c75832` defines `fetch_from_gerrit()` as `git fetch ${{ inputs.gerrit-url }}/${{ inputs.gerrit-project }} ${{ inputs.gerrit-refspec }}`, and run 33455923923 shows the workflow supplied `gerrit-url: https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com` plus `gerrit-project: rebar`, so the fallback URL form is `https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/rebar`. The action fetches the GitHub mirror through `origin`; the workflow will recreate that source explicitly as `https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}.git` in the initialized workspace.

Implementation steps:

1. Initialize a git repository in the empty runner workspace and add `origin=https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}.git`.
2. Fetch `GERRIT_REFSPEC` into `FETCH_HEAD` from `origin`; if that fails, fetch the same refspec from `https://${{ vars.GERRIT_SERVER }}/${{ inputs.GERRIT_PROJECT }}`. Do not check out either fetch result yet.
3. If neither fetch succeeds, fail with a clear error naming both attempted sources and the refspec.
4. Compare `git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD^{commit}` to `GERRIT_PATCHSET_REVISION`; if they differ, fail with a clear dispatch-input error naming the refspec SHA and expected SHA. This is the repaired form of run 33455923923.
5. Only after the fetch/refspec SHA matches, check out `GERRIT_PATCHSET_REVISION` explicitly in detached HEAD mode and verify `git rev-parse HEAD` equals it before any Python/Jira DC setup or live DC operation runs.

Strengthen `tests/unit/test_jira_dc_exact_patchset_workflow.py` by replacing the old `test_uses_pinned_gerrit_checkout_action` assertion with contract tests for the new shape: the workflow must not use the refspec-first third-party checkout action in this lane, its checkout shell must fail on an inconsistent temporary-git refspec/revision pair without checking out the refspec commit, its checkout shell must fail clearly when neither source has the requested refspec, and its success path must leave `HEAD == GERRIT_PATCHSET_REVISION`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The Jira DC exact-patchset parity workflow checks out the exact requested Gerrit patchset SHA before any live DC operation runs; checked by `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" pytest tests/unit/test_jira_dc_exact_patchset_workflow.py -q` and by the existing `HEAD == GERRIT_PATCHSET_REVISION` guard embedded in the workflow.
- [ ] If the requested patchset refspec cannot be fetched from either the GitHub mirror or Gerrit fallback, the workflow fails with a clear fetch/input error rather than landing on a different commit; checked by a focused temporary-git test in `tests/unit/test_jira_dc_exact_patchset_workflow.py`.
- [ ] The workflow records enough evidence for a future CI dispatch to prove the live Data Center lane ran from `HEAD == expected_sha`; in-session completion rests on AC1/AC2 plus Gerrit review/Verified results, and the future live dispatch evidence is a GitHub Actions run id whose summary lists the verified SHA.
  provenance: environment=GitHub Actions workflow_dispatch with real Jira Data Center image; principal=Gerrit/GitHub workflow actor; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=static-analysis — the real Jira DC Docker image only runs in CI, so this session proves the checkout/verify plumbing locally and relies on Gerrit `Verified` plus a future explicit dispatch for the live DC body.

## Testing
- `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" pytest tests/unit/test_jira_dc_exact_patchset_workflow.py -q`
- `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make lint`
- `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make typecheck`
- `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make test`

Do not run the real Jira DC parity body locally; the operator confirmed the real Data Center Docker image used by this lane only runs in CI.

file_impact.reason: Replace the third-party Gerrit checkout action with deterministic fetch-by-refspec plus checkout-by-requested-SHA logic so the live DC lane cannot proceed on a stale or mismatched patchset.
Strengthen the config-as-artifact tests to require deterministic exact-SHA checkout and clear refspec/SHA mismatch failure before the live Jira DC body.
